# Background

## Motivation

- Level-1 headings (`#`) group slides into sections
- Level-2 headings (`##`) start a new slide
- Remove `hide-section-slides` above to show a divider slide for each section

## Related Work

::: {.callout-note title="Citations"}
Add a `bibliography:` to the front matter and cite with `[@key]`.
Each slide then lists the references it cites along its bottom edge.
:::
